The '''CMC-RP05 resource pad''' was a scaled-down version of the [[CMC-22 mining facility]] developed by the [[Corellia Mining Corporation/Legends|Corellia Mining Corporation]]. The resource pad mined and processed raw materials with a high rate of loss and was usually used at resource-rich locations that could be strip-mined. Both the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used resource pads to quickly mine raw materials to sell off for credits, giving a share of the profits to the [[Corellia Mining Corporation/Legends|Corellia Mining Corporation]] in return for its use.
